In Step 9, the WebSurfer successfully found that Jean Bretagne Charles de La Tr moille (the father) was the son of "Charles Armand Ren  de La Tr moille". The correct paternal grandfather is therefore Charles Armand Ren  de La Tr moille. However, in Step 10, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the paternal grandfather was "Charles Louis Bretagne de La Tr moille". This is a logical failure where the Planner confused the names of the grandfather (Charles Armand) and the great-grandfather (Charles Louis), likely due to the repetitive naming conventions in the family tree (multiple Charleses) and a failure to correctly map the generational hierarchy (Father -> Grandfather -> Great-Grandfather). The Planner prematurely declared the task complete with the wrong name instead of verifying the lineage chain against the explicit data provided in the search results.
